title: Ticket run metrics — one JSON receipt per slice run (T-913.2)
description: Files live at .ai/tickets/metrics/<ticket-id>/<ts>-<sha>.json, one per run, never a jsonl. tokens_consumed is REQUIRED and total must equal input+output+cache_read+cache_write (reasoning is a sibling observation, never summed). finished/outcome/git_sha are stamps `platform wave land` writes; elapsed is derived (finished - started) at query time, never stored. Validated by `ticket check` via xtask/src/metrics.rs, which also enforces the RFC 3339 UTC rule from crates/tbd-tickets.
